soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.64–0.67, lateral margins nearly parallel, posterior margin largely straight, frontal region flat. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles rather straight, only the apex slightly curved; length 0.60 of head capsule length and 0.93–0.94 of head width. Antennae 15 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal and widening posteriorly; waist region slender and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.31–0.33. Pronotum trapezoidal, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, anterior margin with a shallow incision in the middle, the incision at the middle of the posterior margin indistinct; about 30 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
